Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber Propane grill;  It is very solid BUT there are 2 versions of this item. The one I purchased was from Lowes with a solid enclosed lower compartment and the one I saw at Home Depot had grilles. I am sure the one I purchased has more solidity and will keep the elements out better. This grill has enough cooking space for a family of 4, heats up very quickly and retains its heat. One of the major reasons I went with Weber this time was because my previous grills from "no name" manufacturers were impossible to get replacement parts for.  Weber's online store has everything I will hopefully need, and Ace Hardware, HD, and Lowes all carry a bunch of spare parts.  The wide grill bars make for great char marks, clean up relatively easily.  My main complaint so far -- they have a "Fuel gauge" which really is weighing your propane bottle and gives you a visual scale. While I like this feature, hanging the propane bottle on the scale's hook is dodgy and I have to bend at a weird angle to get this installed. Not so easy with a full propane bottle.  Other than that I have been very satisfied with this, clean up is easy and I love the disposable catch trays.  I went ahead and bought a cover, and so far it has maintained it's new exterior look.  I'll post later with any pluses or minuses.
Results.Title: Only one issue so far

Results.ReviewText: I am a first time griller at age 79 and had never paid much attention to the process of "grilling."  But not wanting to go without wonderful grilled food, I bought a Weber, not even sure I could learn how to use it.  Oh boy!  How easy it is!  Great instructions, it lights every time I turn it on (amazing!), and once I figured out what direct and indirect heat was, I was on my way.  After only two months, I am now grilling everything.  I've done pork, chicken, steak, hamburgers, kebabs, ribs, all kinds of veges, including potatoes.  The Spirit is perfect for me because I can grill enough just for me, or I can have friends over (who are amazed at my new skills) and cook up a storm.  I love my Spirit.  Thank you, Weber!

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-310 is a fantastic gas grill. It’s a work horse grill with its three gas burners and plenty of grill space for grilling food. It’s large enough for grilling all kinds of food, but small enough not to be in the way on our deck. It’s small but big enough for the whole family, with large grill space and a smaller body. Way to go Weber!

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-310 Gas Grill has worked well in the first two months of ownership.  The heating performance has been excellent and it is relatively easy to clean.  No issues with performance to date.  Everything assembled easily and appears well engineered.  However, the true measure of an excellent grill is how it continues to perform after several years.  Corrosion protection and long lived components are key to the long term satisfaction of owning a good grill.  Anyone can deliver a grill that will last 2 or 3 years, but it is more of a challenge for the grill to continue to perform and look good after the first few years.  Therefore, not enough time to really judge the long term satisfaction yet.

Results.Title: Love my new Weber

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely amazing value for the price.  Will only purchase Weber for the rest of my life.  This 3 Burner provides multiple heat zones to effectively cook multiple pieces of food exactly how you want to.  This 3 burner is the perfect size for my growing family.  I will be upgrading to a bigger Weber later in life.  Simply for added features like rotisserie array and side burner.
Results.Title: Weber Gold Standard

Results.ReviewText: Great grill easy to use and to get started without any troubles.
Results.Title: Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: Love the stainless steel and the cast iron cooking grates.  The electric ignition is very nice too.  Just the right size for a family of 4.  My 1st grill was a Webber Genesis II and I've had it since 1997.  Just thought it was time for a more modern upgrade.  But after replacing the burners I gave my old Webber to my in-laws, so it's still going.
Results.Title: Out with the old but still grillin.

Results.ReviewText: I should’ve upgraded to Weber from lower-priced/ lower-quality brands a long time ago. You get what you pay for. It’s worth it.
Results.Title: Worth the $

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased my second Spirit E-310 Gas Grill. I was so impressed with the durability of my first one however not so much with my new one that is a few weeks old. It works great, does great barbecuing, however it doesn't seem to be holding up as well as my first one. The chrome around the temperature controls and other areas seem to be rusting after my first use. I have cleaned and polished to no avail.
Results.Title: Spirit E-310 chrome started rusting after one use

Results.ReviewText: Very well made grill .Wish the motor mount was on the other side
Results.Title: GRILLING ON THE 4th

Results.ReviewText: very good grill, really enjoying it so far this summer. Have to clean it alot. Assembly and ease of use are real positives
Results.Title: First Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is our first Weber and easily the best grill we've ever owned.  I never knew food could taste this good on a gas grill.  It's easy to use, easy to take apart and clean.  I really love the design which is very clean and uncluttered and will make it easy to clean and maintain.  We've only had ours a couple months but I see reviews of folks replacing 10 year old grills so looking forward to many years with our new Weber.
Results.Title: Best Grill We've Ever Owned

Results.ReviewText: It is very different from any other grill I have owned.  Cooking time is amazing and there are less flare-ups.  This leaves food tasting wonderful.
Results.Title: Amazing Grill

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
